claim_clauses.claim: Any polynomial/trivial-Kan resolution computes the same cotangent complex canonically in D(B)
claim_clauses.exact_unavailable_interface: For the opposite category C_B/A of polynomial A-algebra factorizations into B, construct the derived colimit Lpi! on contravariant B-module diagrams. If U_bullet is a cosimplicial object with each Mor_C(U_bullet,U) simplicial set contractible, prove that evaluation F(U_bullet) computes Lpi!F functorially. Supply the projective representable-diagram resolution and first-quadrant double-complex proof. Polynomial/trivial-Kan resolutions meet the hypothesis because those mapping sets are products of contractible augmentation fibers. The product/fiber/contractibility lifting proof must also be supplied, including arbitrary-index AC.

Prove the free-forgetful standard resolution has its underlying-set contraction (extra degeneracy), and prove the simplicial abelian-group criterion turning a surjective weak-equivalence augmentation into a trivial Kan fibration. The current standard-resolution item states this property using the source but does not supply the criterion/contraction proof prerequisite.

claim_clauses.claim: Canonical comparison after a Tor-independent change of target
claim_clauses.exact_unavailable_interface: Prove derived module extension of scalars commutes with derived colimit on the polynomial-factorization diagram categories, and prove that their category-change functor preserves derived colimit when a shared contractible cosimplicial resolution computes both. P_bullet tensor_A A' is again admissible when the canonical derived tensor maps quasi-isomorphically to ordinary B'. These diagram-category comparisons are not supplied by the published bounded-above tensor/Tor results.

Apply the preceding derived category-change comparison to A->A'->B with B tensor_A^L A'->B a quasi-isomorphism, and use ordinary differential base change. This source formula is valid and retained; its source proof still uses the unavailable category-homology comparison.

claim_clauses.exact_unavailable_interface: Supply the simplicial ring/module model structures, derived mapping spaces, and three Quillen adjunctions: extension/forgetful for A-algebras over B; augmented B-algebras versus nonunital B-algebras (kernel and adjoining B); indecomposables versus zero-multiplication B-modules. HAGII's argument uses assumptions1.1.0.1-1.1.0.4; their instantiation for simplicial modules/algebras imports Quillen and monoidal transfer results and has no local suppliers.
